description: Defines a custom web component 'x-pagination' for rendering and handling pagination controls in a web application.

classes.name: XPagination
classes.description: A custom web component extending WebComponent to manage pagination UI and behavior.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Getter that retrieves the current page number from attributes.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Setter that updates the current page number attribute.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Initializes pagination parameters and calculates page links when the component is connected to the DOM.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the HTML for pagination controls based on current state.

methods.name: onclick
methods.description: Handles click events on pagination links, fetches new page content.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP fetch request to retrieve page content.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Updates target element's innerHTML with fetched content.
